title: From Oil to Copper, Supply Risks Drive Commodities Higher | Insight with Haslinda Amin 9/8/2026
description:
Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture.

Chapters:
00:00:01 - Insight with Haslinda Amin Begins
00:01:01 - Oil extends gain as Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman is close
00:03:18 - opper hits all-time high amid tariff turmoil, mine struggles
00:05:48 - Standard Chartered's Eric Robertsen on structural commodity shortages
00:13:04 - Yen strengthens past 154 per dollar as rally continues
00:16:21 - Eric Robertsen on the risk of more aggressive Bank of Japan tightening
00:23:27 - Sapporo Breweries' Rieso Shofu on moving some production from Canada to the US
00:27:13 - Canada set to hit at Trump tariffs, risking wider trade war
00:31:34 - World Trade Council of Wichita's Usha Haley on Canada’s tariffs and impact on US 
00:41:24 - How expat salaries, living costs compare in Singapore, Hong Kong
